questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height listed on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or roadway pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass safely. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. Multiple chevron signs may be placed throughout a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular yield sign means you must slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an island, median, or barrier ahead. Drive to the right side of it as shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign tells you that the road curves ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Be prepared to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps entering vehicles merge smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mark railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in crosswalks. Stay alert for children when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs indicate a no passing zone. You cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows rules drivers must follow. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Left turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: Do not drive past this sign. You are going the wrong way on a one-way street and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows rules drivers must follow. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows rules drivers must follow. Left turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the pavement is wet because the road may be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be prepared to let them merge safely.
